zh-CN.name: 深维智讯·课程推荐
zh-CN.description: 从录音分析、复盘总结等任意分析报告提取学员短板，自动匹配或创建培训课程，经确认后向指定学员批量下发培训任务并飞书通知。
examples: 处理这份录音分析报告并下发培训任务
根据复盘总结给学员安排培训

en.name: Recommend courses
en.description: Extract weaknesses from any analysis report, match or create training courses, and dispatch tasks to selected students after confirmation.
examples: Process this analysis report and dispatch training tasks
Arrange training from the review summary
